title: decode_line() has #[allow(dead_code)] despite being pub(crate) and used by scan.rs
description: uuencoding/src/decode.rs line 151: decode_line() is marked #[allow(dead_code)] and pub(crate). It is used by scan.rs (uuencoding/src/scan.rs line 3). The allow(dead_code) was presumably added to silence a compiler warning during development but was not removed. Since the function is actually used, the attribute is misleading and will confuse anyone wondering why dead_code is suppressed on a used function.
acceptance_criteria: Remove the #[allow(dead_code)] attribute from decode_line(). Verify cargo build still compiles cleanly.
